**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 19.2, p0076).**

- **What's compliant:** § 19.1 (professional and workmanlike, conformance to documentation), § 19.3 (no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law), § 19.4 (re-perform/repair/replace, then refund; non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security), and § 19.5 (disclaimer expressly does not limit any express warranty) all meet the playbook.
- **The problem:** § 19.2 limits Deliverable conformance to fifteen days after delivery and adds that "after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation" — well short of the preferred 12 months (software) / 90 days (services), and the sunset also switches off the § 19.4 remedy.
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** twelve months for Deliverables and delivered software, ninety days for Services, with the § 19.4 correction/replacement/refund obligations expressly preserved for nonconformities reported in the period. Fallback of 90/30 days flagged in the comment.
